name: soak
_comment: Long run at the last passing stage of real-app.json (set it with --stages N, --host <sender IP>): 30 min hold with chat and DVR, memory slope per minute and recovery after the viewers leave. Target statistics from /api/stats. Traffic cap 300 GB covers 100 viewers x 30 min at 8.6 Mbit/s (~195 GB); lower stages use less.
